title: IncomingEvent
description: AQG Project Ledger — the producer→inbox contract (EAF exporter / aqg-hook / manual emit this). NOT StoredEvent: recorded_at + ledger_seq are AQG-generated at write time and MUST NOT appear here (additionalProperties:false enforces it). schema_version 1.1 (accepts 1.0/1.1 during rollout; 1.1 adds the milestone + decision kinds).

schema_version.description: Contract version. 1.1 = 1.0 + the milestone/decision kinds (a strict superset; progress/defect/handoff unchanged), so a 1.1 consumer accepts BOTH during rollout for backward compat. milestone/decision require 1.1 (see allOf). AQG inbox routes an unsupported version to failed/ for replay (does not crash).

event_id.description: <source>:<run_or_session_id>:<producer_seq>. Path-segment-safe alphabet [A-Za-z0-9._:-]; paths.py percent-encodes it to an injective cross-platform inbox filename. maxLength 200 keeps the inbox filename under the OS limit (ENAMETOOLONG) and the producer_seq tail bounded. producer_seq is per-LedgerEvent unique (NOT per-transition). The source-prefix MUST equal the top-level source (enforced by the per-source branches below). Retrying the same business action reuses the SAME event_id (idempotency). NOT a content hash.

content_checksum.description: Optional, ADVISORY only: sha256(payload) transport hint. AQG does NOT recompute or verify it and it is NOT used for dedup (event_id is the idempotency key). Treat as informational, not an integrity guarantee.

project.description: project_id = normalized target-repo identity (one target_repo = one project). Canonically an 'owner/repo' slug or 'local:<16-hex>'. It is the on-disk partition key, so conformance.py treats this as a SAFETY gate and ADDITIONALLY rejects any '.'/'..' segment (path traversal) that this shape pattern cannot express. Aggregation primary key; MUST be stable per repo. See contracts/ledger/project_id.py.

source.description: Provenance. EAF exporter sends 'eaf'. Only 'eaf' + 'manual' drive the defect state machine; 'aqg-hook' is low-fidelity (progress only).

source_ref.description: Back-reference to the source, filled by source. Never copies source-side detail — just a handle.

payload.description: Shape depends on kind — constrained by the allOf branches below.

occurred_at.description: Event time from the producer clock (display only; AQG orders by ledger_seq, not this).

allOf.comment: provenance: event_id source-prefix must equal the source field

aqg-hook is progress-only (low-fidelity); it must not emit defect/milestone/decision — the projection ignores those for aqg-hook, so accepting one writes a dead event into the append-only log. progress + handoff stay allowed.
version×kind gate: milestone/decision are 1.1-only (a4 §5.6 capability handshake); a 1.0 event must not carry them — conformance rejects it to dead-letter.

milestone/decision lifecycles need a monotonic producer_seq — the §5.1.1 UUID escape hatch is excluded (a3:T1 / acceptance ⑪). event_id is '<seg>:<seg>:<producer_seq>'; reject when the producer_seq segment (everything after the 2nd colon) is ITSELF a canonical hyphenated UUID. Anchored to the whole 3rd segment to match conformance.py is_uuid(producer_seq(event_id)) — a bare ':UUID$' over-rejected a colon-containing tail that merely ENDS in a UUID (audit 996d6911 C2).

payload.description: NO 'status' field — current status is projected by AQG from the action stream (additionalProperties:false rejects a stray status).

defect_id.description: stable across a bug's lifetime; AQG projects state from same-defect_id events

title.description: required on opened; non-empty when present

allOf.comment: milestone (a4 §5.2): the 4-state business milestone (planned→started→completed/cancelled). NO 'status' — projected from the action stream. milestone_id MAY recur across sources (write-plan plans / EAF executes the same id); the projection reduces by action semantics, not cross-source seq (a4 §5.3).

milestone_id.description: unique within (project_id); may appear across sources (a4 §5.2)

estimated_size.description: SIZE not wall-clock (a4 §5.2 [a4:T]): '~N person-weeks (human-team baseline)' + optional T-shirt; required on planned. The ONLY planning-time time concept; does NOT predict EAF wall-clock.

planned_start.description: optional calendar field; does NOT drive progress/health

target_date.description: optional, human-baseline; does NOT drive progress/health (a4 §5.2 [a4:T] — no early/late, no overdue). When both present, planned_start <= target_date (enforced by conformance — a cross-field invariant not expressible in draft-07; schema is not a complete mirror for it).

actual_date.description: actual completion date; required on completed

actual_wallclock.description: optional EAF actual elapsed time (e.g. '14 minutes'), recorded on completed (a4 §5.2 [a4:T])

replan.description: explicit re-plan past a terminal state (a4 §5.3); a planned action after completed/cancelled is honored only with replan=true

allOf.comment: decision (a4 §9 OQ-2): an owner decision the report surfaces as the structured 'pending your decision' item. a4 §9 names the fields (question/options/rationale/blocks); the raised/resolved `action` verb is the AQG append-only action-stream idiom (symmetry with defect/milestone) so the projection can drop a resolved decision from the pending list. NO 'status' — state is projected from the action stream.

decision_id.description: stable across the decision's lifetime; AQG projects state from same-decision_id events

question.description: what the owner must decide; required on raised
